evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: The second acetone rinse was added to the cleaning procedure in 2000 via change request CR-2000-008.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2000-008
evidence.claim: In 2000, the second acetone rinse was added to prevent color carry-over for the BW-90 white topcoat used by Carrozzerie Vetta.
evidence.quote: white topcoat BW-90 for Carrozzerie Vetta requires zero colour carry-over. Since any vessel may be used for BW-90

evidence.title: SUPPLIER QUALITY REQUIREMENTS - TOPCOAT BW-90
evidence.claim: In 2000, Carrozzerie Vetta required zero tolerance for color contamination for the BW-90 white topcoat.
evidence.quote: Colour tolerance: delta E 0.3 maximum versus master. Zero tolerance for colour contamination.

evidence.title: Product portfolio memo PM-2015-001
evidence.claim: The BW-90 white topcoat was discontinued on January 1, 2015, and no light-colored topcoats remain in production.
evidence.quote: Discontinued from 1 January 2015: BW-90 white topcoat - the Carrozzerie Vetta supply contract ended on 31/12/2014
